object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Through set_table, give an object a two-column table, aligned left and right, with a header row and a body row whose one cell spans both columns; read the object with show_object; remove the table through clear_table. In the library, replace one table with another. Expected: set_table returns ok naming the object file; show_object returns the alignments left and right, the first row as a header row and the column span 2; after the replacement the object holds exactly one table, equal to the new one; after clear_table the object file holds no table.
